sections.A: SCI mein spinal cord zakhmi hoti hai aur chot ke level se neeche movement, sensation aur jism ka khud-kaar control (BP, peshab) mutasir hota hai.
sections.B: Table batata hai ke har level par (complete injury mein) kya kaam mumkin hai, jaise C6 par wrist extension se tenodesis grip.
sections.C: Level aur AIS grade, reedh ki stability aur brace ke orders, surgery, saans ka haal aur skin.
sections.D: Saans (vital capacity, khansi ki taaqat), ISNCSCI motor aur sensory exam, tone, range aur skin.
sections.G: Achanak tez sar dard, BP bohat zyada, chot ke upar paseena aur laali (autonomic dysreflexia): foran wajah dhoondein (bhara mutha bladder, qabz) aur medical madad.
sections.H: Shuru mein spinal precautions, saans ki care, positioning aur passive range; stable hone par dheere dheere baithna aur rehab.
sections.I: Saans ki exercises, assisted cough, transfers, wheelchair skills, taaqat aur jahan mumkin ho chalne ki training.
sections.K: Kuch patients mein FES cycling aur FES walking; standing frame se khade hona.
sections.M: ISNCSCI, SCIM, chalne ke measures aur saans ke measures dobara dekhein.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. C6 complete injury mein tenodesis grasp sikhaya ja sakta hai.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
